$comment: Filter config for bundled completion specs. The source package/version is pinned in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml. Edit exclude here, then run `node scripts/sync-bundled-specs.mjs` and commit the regenerated bundle/specs. Env vars BUNDLED_SPECS_EXCLUDE / BUNDLED_SPECS_PACKAGE / BUNDLED_SPECS_SOURCE still override one-off runs. See CLAUDE.md > Bundled Specs.
